question: Which dated decisions in the next year will show whether each NSSTS company's position is real?
answer: 34 dated decisions across 12 companies run from August 27, 2026 to December 31, 2027; 2 have passed with no recorded outcome, and the next is due October 31, 2026 (BAE Systems Information and Electronic Systems Integration Inc.).

sections.title: The calendar
sections.sub: Each entry names the company, what would move its position up or down, and links the record it rests on.

rows.what: Argonne or DOE records the final center integration, financing or capacity object.
rows.detail: Up if: A follow-on center agreement, accepted capacity or named financing and integration role. Down if: Another integrator takes the expansion role or Oracle's scope materially contracts.

rows.what: The Navy definitizes the civilian-mariner wireless contract and records site or cybersecurity acceptance.
rows.detail: Up if: Definitized value and accepted deployments across named sites. Down if: Material scope reduction, persistent installation delay or cyber-authorization failure.

rows.what: MAVRC downselect, prototype and security-certification path
rows.who: BAE Systems Information and Electronic Systems Integration Inc.
rows.detail: Up if: Phase 2 selection, prototype order and quantitative receiver-resilience or certification result. Down if: Design rejection, competitor downselect or platform security-certification failure.

rows.what: Dual Band Decoy delivery and platform acceptance
rows.who: BAE Systems Information and Electronic Systems Integration Inc.
rows.detail: Up if: Accepted assemblies, reliability evidence, platform expansion or a follow-on lot. Down if: Qualification, delivery or integration failure or absence of follow-on production.

rows.what: DOE publishes the executed FORGE assistance agreement, obligation and first accepted milestone.
rows.detail: Up if: Award number, obligation and delivered FORGE result tied to GE Vernova Operations LLC. Down if: Negotiations are rescinded, scope is canceled or another GE entity is the unresolved performer.

rows.what: FITT equipment reaches public commissioning and accepted performance testing.
rows.detail: Up if: Full-scale utility deployment and public performance acceptance. Down if: Failed demonstration, cancellation or no credible scale path.

rows.what: DARPA RPM independent metric result and operating-customer transition
rows.detail: Up if: Published IV&V pass or a follow-on production or service acquisition naming Ginkgo Bioworks, Inc. Down if: Failed verification or program close without an operational transition.

rows.what: Current surveillance or diagnostic-network instrument and exact signatory
rows.detail: Up if: A current CDC, BARDA or other federal award with funded scope and accepted operating milestones. Down if: No renewal, funding contraction, or a new award to a different legal entity or competitor.

rows.what: AMDT3 environmental qualification and build progression
rows.detail: Up if: Accepted spacecraft milestone, launch assignment or demonstrated fire-control-quality tracking. Down if: Sensor shortfall, environmental-test failure, delivery slip or launch reassignment.

rows.what: GPS IIIF delivery and successor-transition evidence
rows.detail: Up if: Accepted GPS IIIF flight article, assigned launch or successful on-orbit checkout. Down if: Material satellite, launch, control-segment or certification delay.

rows.what: Hypersonic repeat test and NGI interceptor qualification
rows.detail: Up if: Repeat successful all-up-round event, qualified production or successful interceptor test. Down if: Flight-test failure, schedule breach, IOC delay or loss of follow-on production.

rows.what: QTIME rapid-inspection performance and transition
rows.detail: Up if: Accepted speed and repeatability result followed by use on a qualified production part. Down if: Metric failure, data-rights dispute or absence of a transition customer.

rows.what: GPI controlled-flight and intercept progression
rows.detail: Up if: Successful controlled flight, representative intercept or production decision. Down if: Design failure, cancellation, competitor downselect or schedule erosion.

rows.what: SM-6 and SM-3 accepted production lots and follow-on options
rows.detail: Up if: Expanded accepted lots, on-time delivery and exercised production options. Down if: Test failure, lot rejection, delivery disruption or follow-on loss.

rows.what: HELWS current follow-on and operational evidence
rows.detail: Up if: Named production or JIATF-401 selection plus accepted reliability and target-effect results. Down if: No funded follow-on or adverse sustainment and effectiveness results.

rows.what: PHASER transition, safety and lethality evidence
rows.detail: Up if: Current service procurement and accepted electromagnetic-safety and target-effect results. Down if: Continued absence of a funded follow-on or adverse electromagnetic-compatibility result.

rows.what: NSSL and SDA missions maintain clean launch cadence and accepted orbital delivery.
rows.detail: Up if: On-time mission execution with accepted payload deployment. Down if: Mission-assurance failure, major delay or reassignment of an ordered mission.

rows.what: SSC publishes measurable Space Data Network prototype integration or delivery progress.
rows.detail: Up if: Demonstrated end-to-end optical-mesh performance or exercised service options. Down if: Schedule slip, material scope reduction or failed integration milestone.

rows.what: NNSA or DOE publishes a named scientific-cloud task, workload expansion or contribution-consumption record.
rows.detail: Up if: A named American Science Cloud task order or disclosed workload expansion tied to Amazon Web Services, Inc. Down if: Declared capacity remains unused outside the existing NNSA environment or another cloud becomes the operating scientific platform.

rows.what: M2PC or next DOE autonomous-platform contract and construction milestone
rows.detail: Up if: Named instrument, accepted milestone or an additional commissioned laboratory deployment. Down if: Scope reduction, commissioning delay or adverse closed-loop acceptance result.

rows.what: DOE or a national laboratory issues a named data-layer or operational-AI implementation object.
rows.detail: Up if: A Genesis, American Science Cloud or ModCon deployment names Palantir USG, Inc. Down if: Participation remains advisory or DOE selects another operating data platform.

rows.what: DISA publishes Thunderdome option exercise and accepted migration milestones.
rows.detail: Up if: Confirmed DAFA or combatant-command migrations under exercised options. Down if: Option lapse, migration failure or architecture replacement.

rows.what: HELIOS operational acceptance and replication
rows.detail: Up if: Published operational-test acceptance, reliable sailor-operated performance or a second-ship award. Down if: Persistent reliability or maintainability limits, adverse operational test or no fleet replication.

rows.what: A DoW component issues and funds an Oracle ESI task order for a named workload.
rows.detail: Up if: Funded task order and documented operating deployment under the agreement. Down if: No material ordering, option non-exercise or replacement by another enterprise architecture.

rows.what: Terminal and radio order conversion, qualification and field acceptance
rows.detail: Up if: Material funded orders and documented accepted performance at fleet scale in both lanes. Down if: Low order conversion, qualification failure, adverse field performance or contract-scope reduction.

rows.what: DISA publishes IL6 expansion, task-order use or accepted operational-edge workload transitions.
rows.detail: Up if: Additional accepted mission workloads or a confirmed IL6 AWS service are recorded. Down if: Theater withdrawal, cloud-provider displacement or loss of a required authorization.

rows.what: Army releases order-level funding, field-acceptance or performance evidence for later Maven increments.
rows.detail: Up if: Additional funded orders and published operational acceptance. Down if: Order shortfall, architecture replacement, data-rights conflict or termination.

rows.what: Annual entity review confirms the exact GE Vernova Operations performer and preserves affiliate separation.
rows.detail: Up if: Award papers and ownership records converge on the exact entity across both sectors. Down if: Federal work belongs to a different affiliate, is novated without resolution or remains brand-only.

rows.what: PTS-P flight-article build and schedule integrity
rows.detail: Up if: Accepted spacecraft milestone, completed flight integration or an on-schedule launch assignment. Down if: Prototype schedule failure, anti-jam threshold failure or loss of follow-on production.

rows.what: Annual entity review confirms Palantir USG remains the federal subsidiary and no contracting seam has shifted.
rows.detail: Up if: Exact-entity continuity plus a named DOE operating object. Down if: Federal work moves to another subsidiary or the DOE bridge remains uncontracted.

rows.what: NSWC Dahlgren releases and awards the planned HPM engineering-support follow-on.
rows.detail: Up if: A follow-on award retains the incumbent HPM vulnerability, lethality and prototype-evaluation scope. Down if: Recompete loss, cancellation or material migration of the HPM scope.

rows.what: The next annual entity and program review confirms Oracle America remains the performer node and both lanes show execution.
rows.detail: Up if: Accepted cross-sector delivery and continued exact-entity continuity. Down if: Entity migration, contract novation without resolution or lack of operating evidence in either lane.

rows.what: Sustained ordering and operating evidence shows whether AWS remains a cross-sector rail rather than a one-period installed position.
rows.detail: Up if: Repeated funded orders and accepted performance across NNSA and DoW environments. Down if: Material scope contraction, repeated service failure or migration away from AWS.

rows.what: Planned operational prototype delivery reaches government acceptance and authorization.
rows.detail: Up if: SSC records accepted operational prototype performance and transitions to sustained service. Down if: The prototype misses end-2027 acceptance, is terminated or fails required optical-mesh performance.

uncertain: A gate date is when the package expects a record to exist, not a promise that an agency will act then.
Past due means the date passed and the dossier holds no later check; the outcome may exist outside the registry.
sources: NSSTS Priority Company Dossier Registry (dossiers[].next_gates[]), read in place.
